pow_gate_summary.rule: Every mandatory gate must pass independently. Preliminary screens and shared-runner measurements cannot pass a gate.

pow_gates.gap: One million matching vectors across two independent implementations and three CPU architectures are not complete.
The preserved screen used eight shared-runner seeds, not 1024 unbiased seeds per device.
The complete controlled matrix on three declared low-cost systems is absent.
No exact attacker has demonstrated total measured attack memory at or below half the declared scratch memory, and two independent models are absent.
Batches through 4096 were screened, but the advantage after ordinary hardware occupancy is not measured on controlled hardware.
Optimized implementations across three CPU classes and two GPU ecosystems are absent.
An independently reviewed FPGA implementation or estimate is absent.
Two independently reviewed ASIC cost models are absent.
Two independent reversible-circuit estimates and an approved economic first-mover model are absent.

One packaged labnet miner process directly publishes and survives optional accounting loss. The authenticated Job Declaration v0 behavior and nine semantic failure transcripts are frozen, but binary network integration, a second interoperable implementation, noncustodial payouts, and adversarial switching are absent.

latest_evidence.conclusion: Informational only; exact output used external storage and unbounded OS caching, so the time-memory gate remains open.
Dependency and batch diagnostics found substantial reuse and setup amortization, but did not produce exact proofs after cache misses.
Exact no-spill outputs retained 0.06 percent of ordinary throughput but used 150 percent peak scratch allocation.
Metadata-aware caches leave material misses even for an unattainable oracle, but miss counts are not executable recomputation proofs.
Independent implementations commit to exact scratch read-from generations and expose byte-accounted graph layouts; this is offline structure, not an attack.
An optimistic cut-set argument establishes nonzero replay floors under half-scratch value capacity but is not an executable schedule.
Concrete graph-only schedules require millions of abstract replays and multi-megabyte direct action streams, but omit historical VM state and are not executable attacks.
A one-arena online evaluator independently reproduces exact prefixes and refuses without output at the first materialized cache miss; it does not yet reconstruct missing values.
One missing value and matching historical VM state are independently reconstructed inside the same arena before execution refuses without output at the next miss.
Repeated exact reconstruction recovers 109 to 137 missing values before the flat sparse replay table fills; every standard case refuses without a proof output.
Bitmap-ranked packing extends the exact prefix but incurs 180.8 GB of charged insertion movement on standard seed zero; no proof output is reached.
Fixed replay pages reduce insertion movement by approximately 986 times but exhaust at 59.2 percent slot utilization and do not produce a proof.
Indexed lookup and adjacent-gap rebalancing raise standard seed-zero utilization to 90.8 percent but still exhaust without a proof after 5.13 million attempted replay iterations.

All 17 standard seed-zero cuts exceed the half-scratch ceiling even under an optimistic future-aware staged store; this rejects one no-regeneration checkpoint representation, not all reduced-memory attacks.

The first exact historical value is recursively regenerated inside a logically byte-accounted half-scratch arena before the pilot refuses without a proof at the next miss; physical memory remains unmeasured.

Persistent recursive memo reuse recovers 51 standard seed-zero misses under a one-million-iteration replay ceiling; every screened allocation refuses without an exact proof and physical memory remains unmeasured.
The best of 14 compact machine-state checkpoint allocations reaches iteration 892 versus 999 without checkpoints under the same replay ceiling; the policy is rejected and no gate is assessed.

Binding one exact historical target value to each state checkpoint raises the sparse 1/128 allocation from iteration 719 to 999 without increasing depth, but only ties the global attack record and produces no proof.

Twelve 120-byte direct-dependency bundles displace 32 memo entries yet advance the standard seed-zero prefix from a matched 951 baseline to 1006, seven beyond the prior global record; the partial holdout is mixed and incomplete, total call/probe work is not bounded, and no proof is produced.

A five-million-unit ceiling jointly charges recursive calls, replay iterations, memo probes, and checkpoint-entry probes; all eight standard seeds stop exactly at the bound with prefixes from 480 to 999 and no proof, so the replay-only bundle advantage is not preserved.

Native-stack and allocator allowances reduce the attack arena to 85504 bytes, a fixed rolling transcript removes recovery-dependent growth, and eight operation-bounded prefixes range from 641 to 853 with no proof. GCC reports a bounded 352-byte recursive frame; paired whole-process RSS remains shared-runner diagnostic evidence only.

Twenty packed 104-byte suspended frames now reside inside the preallocated attack arena and native recursive self-calls are forbidden. All eight holdout seeds exhaust exactly five million operations at prefixes from 712 to 952 without a proof; no gate is assessed.

Four directly addressed checkpoint time scales improve the frozen eight-seed median prefix from 886 to 945.5 and the maximum from 952 to 982. Every case still exhausts exactly five million operations without a proof, so no gate is assessed.

A second frozen attack family removes machine-state checkpoints and retains cost-ranked historical values in a two-choice frontier. Eight fresh cases reach prefixes from 714 to 828, all exhaust exactly five million operations without a proof, and different seeds prevent a controlled comparison with the checkpoint ladder; no gate is assessed.

The public challenge freezes qualification, screening, and exact-completion artifact contracts, fresh-case assignment, byte and operation accounting, untrusted-code handling, and fail-closed interpretation. It is review infrastructure, not attack evidence, and no gate is assessed.

The public call and evaluator runbook define separate attacker and review roles, conflict disclosure, commit-reveal administration, isolated execution, evidence retention, public issue entry points, and an explicit no-bounty policy. They are participation infrastructure, not attack evidence, and no gate is assessed.

next_milestone.stage_a: Exact versioned scratch graph and byte model implemented; no gate assessed.
next_milestone.stage_b_lower_bound: Optimistic offline cut-set replay floor implemented; no gate assessed.
next_milestone.stage_b_schedule: Concrete graph-only recursive replay schedules implemented with explicit work, depth, retained and transient values, and encoded bytes; not executable and no gate assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_probe: Fail-closed online evaluator scaffold implemented with a one-arena logical budget and independent prefix commitments; every fixed case refuses without output and no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_first_reconstruction: One missing value and matching historical machine state are reconstructed by sparse replay inside the preallocated arena; execution then refuses at the next miss without output.
next_milestone.stage_c_repeated_reconstruction: Repeated exact replay recovers successive misses until the sparse table fills, with cumulative work, depth, transcript, and exhaustion boundaries independently committed; no proof output is reached.
next_milestone.stage_c_packed_checkpoint: Bitmap-ranked packed replay more than doubles retained-value capacity and extends the exact prefix, but sorted insertion creates prohibitive charged byte movement; no proof output is reached.
next_milestone.stage_c_paged_gap: Fixed-size replay pages reduce charged insertion movement by approximately 986 times on standard seed zero, but fragmentation and linear page lookup prevent completion; no proof output is reached.
next_milestone.stage_c_indexed_gap: A byte-accounted page-count index and neighbor rebalancing raise page utilization to 90.8 percent and extend the exact prefix, but repeated genesis replay still exhausts before an output.
next_milestone.stage_c_time_checkpoint_screen: Full snapshots, snapshot-plus-delta, and an optimistic future-aware staged store are screened at 17 cuts; the standard staged floor is 18.63 percent above the half-scratch ceiling, so no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_first_recursive_regeneration: One exact historical value is regenerated through recursive dependencies with a packed memo and logical bounded frame reserve inside the half-scratch arena; the pilot refuses at the next miss and no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_repeated_recursive_regeneration: Persistent memo reuse recovers 51 standard seed-zero misses under a one-million-iteration replay ceiling; a five-point allocation sweep reaches a longest exact prefix of 999 iterations but no proof output.
next_milestone.stage_c_checkpoint_recursive_regeneratio: Fourteen byte-accounted compact checkpoint allocations are screened; the best reaches iteration 892 versus 999 without checkpoints, so this policy is rejected without assessing a gate.
next_milestone.stage_c_target_checkpoint_regeneration: Target-aware 88-byte checkpoints improve the 1/128 allocation from iteration 719 to 999 with bounded depth, but only tie the best prior prefix and fail closed without a proof.
next_milestone.stage_c_dependency_bundle_regeneration: Twelve 120-byte four-value bundles advance the seed-zero prefix to 1006 while displacing 32 memo entries, but a partial holdout is mixed and exposes unbounded call/probe work beyond the replay counter; no proof output is reached.
next_milestone.stage_c_total_operation_bound: One five-million-unit ceiling charges replay iterations, recursive calls, memo probes, and checkpoint probes; all eight standard seeds terminate at the bound with prefixes from 480 to 999 and no proof, rejecting the replay-only bundle advantage without assessing a gate.
next_milestone.stage_c_physical_memory_accounting: The half-scratch budget now deducts a 40960-byte native-stack reserve and 4096-byte allocator allowance before allocating the arena; a rolling transcript has zero recovery-dependent growth, compiler stack-use and whole-process RSS diagnostics are reproducible, prefixes range from 641 to 853, and no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_explicit_iterative_work_stack: Twenty packed 104-byte frames inside the preallocated arena replace native recursive self-calls; all eight frozen cases exhaust exactly five million operations at prefixes from 712 to 952 with no proof, so no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_hierarchical_checkpoint_ladder: Four directly addressed time scales use sixty-four arena-resident target-aware bundles; the frozen eight-seed median rises from 886 to 945.5 and the maximum from 952 to 982, but all cases exhaust five million operations without a proof and no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_frontier_pebbling_attacker: A second frozen family replaces machine-state checkpoints with 9,944 two-choice cost-ranked historical values. Fresh exact prefixes range from 714 to 828; all cases exhaust five million operations without a proof, and no gate is assessed.
next_milestone.stage_c_external_attack_challenge: The public contract defines a qualification preflight, a five-million-operation screening track, an uncapped exact-completion track, deterministic case commitments, fresh assignment after source freeze, a complete memory ledger, and fail-closed evidence interpretation. The package does not execute untrusted submissions or prove their memory claims.
next_milestone.stage_c_independent_research_call: The open call publishes attacker and evaluator entry points, a conflict-aware review runbook, machine-readable campaign status, isolated-execution rules, and an explicit no-bounty policy. No independent submission has yet been received, so the call adds no attack evidence and assesses no gate.
next_milestone.required_outcome: Obtain at least one independently developed submission, freeze its source and manifest before assigning eight fresh cases, review every memory and operation claim, and publish all rows. If an eligible attacker emits an exact canonical proof, begin controlled physical-host measurement; otherwise keep the time-memory gate OPEN and NOT ASSESSED.
